description:
27.5-INCH ALL-TERRAIN BICYCLE - Built for everyday riding and outdoor adventures, this MULTIJOY mountain bike features 27.5-inch wheels that provide a stable grip and responsive handling across paved roads, gravel paths, and light trails.

VERSATILE 21-SPEED DRIVETRAIN - The 21-speed shifting system provides a wide selection of gears for flat roads, inclines, and varied terrain. Smooth gear changes help riders maintain a comfortable cadence during recreational rides, daily commutes, and weekend adventures.

FRONT SUSPENSION COMFORT - The suspension fork helps absorb bumps and vibrations for improved control on uneven surfaces. Combined with ergonomic anti-slip grips, the bicycle delivers a more comfortable and confident riding experience.

RELIABLE DISC BRAKING - Front and rear disc brakes provide responsive stopping performance and dependable control in different riding conditions. The all-terrain tires offer additional traction for everyday road and trail use.

ADJUSTABLE FIT FOR TEENS & ADULTS - The adjustable saddle accommodates riders approximately 5'1" to 6'2" tall and is recommended for ages 13 and older. The durable teal frame, 27.9-inch handlebar, and balanced geometry make it suitable for both men and women.
